title: Added decent 3d model generator to my website (free to try)
author: Jamal_the_3rd
selftext:
So I recently upgraded my 3D generator on my website. I actually get a lot of people who come to the site and just try the 3D generator which has always been surprising because it’s definitely more of a bonus feature than the main point of the site. But I’d love to hear feedback on if people find this to be good enough to use for their games. I really wanted it to be mobile friendly too so it should be good to use on mobile and desktop.

You get 25 free credits for signup and I’ve temporarily reduced the 3d model generator price to 25 credits so you can try a free generation. Personally I find it to work better when you use text-to-3d vs image-to-3d. I’m debating adding 2 more features which is the ability to rig and do some basic animation for your models from within the page, and also adding multi image reference generation which would hopefully improve the existing image-to-3D.

Anyways if anyone wants to give it a spin let me know I’d be happy to give you extra free credits so you can try a few things out. Definitely hoping to get a bit of feedback on how it overall feels.

comments.author: coffetech
comments.body: How do you build your own generator?

replies.author: Jamal_the_3rd
replies.body: I didn't build the actual model, i just built the interface. the model is meshy v6 which is available via their API, but i did make the 3d model viewer that displays the models and lets you move them around. my whole site is basically just a user friendly interface to use different API's

comments.author: andypoly
comments.body: So you just built an interface to mesh AI and charge extra to use?!

replies.author: Jamal_the_3rd
replies.body: Yep. My whole websites purpose is supposed to be an easy all in one generation platform so I have put a lot of work into all the image, video, audio elements/workflows too. The 3d is really just extra but I’m actually running the 3d generation at a loss to let people test it out. But yea that’s business, my target audience is creators that don’t know all the different tools to use just trying to be a user friendly place to do it all

comments.author: _ryseu
comments.body: That is a nice all-in-one AI generation tools. But for me, I didn’t get to test it much since you only give 25 creds for new users. Try posting this on [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) too to get feedback from creators and explorers there. I sometimes do feedback there too.

comments.author: Burger_Fries03
comments.body: Love the idea of this one. This is one of those projects that needs more testers. You'll need to launch this on some platforms out there. More testers/explorers and get real user feedback from your co-builders.
